entries.raw_input: Empir Software Eng (2012) 17:75–89 89 Gregorio Robles is Associate Professor at the Universidad Rey Juan Carlos, which has several campi distributed in the region of Madrid (Spain). He earned his PhD in 2006 and currently has mainly teaching duties in the ﬁeld of computer networks, although he teaches in a master on libre software as well introductory computer courses to journalism students.
